no actual authenticated HTTP cookies or cryptographic draft tokens
parser and full game engine remain legacy JS
pre-existing anonymous event privacy gap not repaired
draft IDs and receipt persistence not production-safe

rust_requirements.title: authenticated batch begin
rust_requirements.rule: server seat/team from auth; each seat owns exactly 5 units; expected match epoch, round and revision

rust_requirements.title: full plan preflight
rust_requirements.rule: validate every policy, tactics, automation, plan, skill, item, Smite, ward, reaction; no silently ignored actions

rust_requirements.title: full state rollback
rust_requirements.rule: rejected batch must leave canonical state hash, event log, order history, RNG and revision exactly unchanged

rust_requirements.title: persist before publish
rust_requirements.rule: atomic persisted checkpoint + receipt + revision before HTTP ack/SSE; storage fault must not release speculative state

rust_requirements.title: dual ready fence
rust_requirements.rule: once one seat is ready, its plans are locked; other seat may plan; second ready executes turn exactly once

rust_requirements.title: owner-only projection
rust_requirements.rule: SSE snapshots, replay, resync, events and receipts are per authenticated seat with default-deny event DTO

rust_requirements.title: request idempotence
rust_requirements.rule: retry identical requestId+canonical payload returns previous ACK even after ready, restore; changed payload is rejected

rust_requirements.title: versioned intent protocol
rust_requirements.rule: typed server-side ParsedIntent schema; client sends only untrusted text/voice and opaque draftId; durable user command receipt

rust_requirements.title: speculative side effects
rust_requirements.rule: no preliminary event, purchase or ID allocation may reach global log during a failed batch

rust_requirements.title: QA parity
rust_requirements.rule: Rust native/WASM with two sessions must execute A12 vectors; keep intentional privacy/atomicity fixes as deliberate divergences
